Bug: The function has a time complexity of O(2^n) due to the repeated calculation of the same subproblems. This is because the function calls itself recursively to calculate the `n`-th Fibonacci number, but it does not store the results of these subproblems.

Expected correction: The function should be modified to use dynamic programming to store the results of the subproblems and avoid repeated calculations. This can be achieved by using a bottom-up approach to calculate the Fibonacci numbers iteratively.
